assertions.description: SharedWorker is a constructor in this context (prerequisite for observing a connect event).
The connect event fired at a new SharedWorkerGlobalScope has data === "" (initialized to the empty string), not null.
assertions.test: new Promise((resolve) => { if (typeof SharedWorker !== 'function') return resolve(false); const w = new SharedWorker('/v160/sharedworkerconnecteventemptystringdata/worker.js', { name: 'conformance-' + Math.random() }); const t = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 4000); w.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(false); }; w.port.onmessage = (m) => { if (m.data && m.data.type === 'connected') { clearTimeout(t); const s = m.data.snapshot; w.port.postMessage({ type: 'bye' }); resolve(s.dataIsEmptyString === true); } }; w.port.start(); })

assertions.description: typeof event.data inside the connect listener is "string".
assertions.test: new Promise((resolve) => { if (typeof SharedWorker !== 'function') return resolve(false); const w = new SharedWorker('/v160/sharedworkerconnecteventemptystringdata/worker.js', { name: 'conformance-' + Math.random() }); const t = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 4000); w.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(false); }; w.port.onmessage = (m) => { if (m.data && m.data.type === 'connected') { clearTimeout(t); const s = m.data.snapshot; w.port.postMessage({ type: 'bye' }); resolve(s.dataTypeof === 'string'); } }; w.port.start(); })

assertions.description: The connect event carries exactly one port in ports, and source is that same port.
assertions.test: new Promise((resolve) => { if (typeof SharedWorker !== 'function') return resolve(false); const w = new SharedWorker('/v160/sharedworkerconnecteventemptystringdata/worker.js', { name: 'conformance-' + Math.random() }); const t = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 4000); w.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(false); }; w.port.onmessage = (m) => { if (m.data && m.data.type === 'connected') { clearTimeout(t); const s = m.data.snapshot; w.port.postMessage({ type: 'bye' }); resolve(s.portsLength === 1 && s.sourceIsPort0 === true); } }; w.port.start(); })

assertions.description: The connect event is a trusted MessageEvent named "connect" that does not bubble and is not cancelable.
assertions.test: new Promise((resolve) => { if (typeof SharedWorker !== 'function') return resolve(false); const w = new SharedWorker('/v160/sharedworkerconnecteventemptystringdata/worker.js', { name: 'conformance-' + Math.random() }); const t = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 4000); w.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(false); }; w.port.onmessage = (m) => { if (m.data && m.data.type === 'connected') { clearTimeout(t); const s = m.data.snapshot; w.port.postMessage({ type: 'bye' }); resolve(s.isMessageEvent && s.type === 'connect' && s.isTrusted && !s.bubbles && !s.cancelable); } }; w.port.start(); })

assertions.description: The connect event's origin and lastEventId are the empty string (not initialized by the constructor steps).
assertions.test: new Promise((resolve) => { if (typeof SharedWorker !== 'function') return resolve(false); const w = new SharedWorker('/v160/sharedworkerconnecteventemptystringdata/worker.js', { name: 'conformance-' + Math.random() }); const t = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 4000); w.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(false); }; w.port.onmessage = (m) => { if (m.data && m.data.type === 'connected') { clearTimeout(t); const s = m.data.snapshot; w.port.postMessage({ type: 'bye' }); resolve(s.origin === '' && s.lastEventId === ''); } }; w.port.start(); })

assertions.description: A script-constructed new MessageEvent('connect') still defaults data to null (MessageEventInit default) — only the browser-fired connect event uses "".
